metrics: fixed accepted predictions, class-matched IoU >= .5; non-crowd GT155; not mAP or deployment success rate
limitations: Old30 is development/calibration, new60 disjoint but COCO not model-unseen.
m is mid-round exploratory addition, thresholds frozen before its own new60 inference.
RF new60/video accuracy measured with PT; old30 PT/ORT parity checked separately.
Video counts/events lack full ground truth and are not precision or recall.

calibration.selection: per class: max TP with FP <= baseline budget; tie higher threshold

benchmark.scope: Pillow decode + official preprocessing + ONNX Runtime inference + output postprocessing

cached_rgb_benchmark.scope: cached decoded RGB + official preprocessing + ONNX Runtime inference + output postprocessing
cached_rgb_benchmark.excluded_from_timing: Pillow image decode and RGB conversion

n-e2e.mode: back-to-back inference, not 1Hz app steady state

s-traditional.mode: back-to-back inference, not 1Hz app steady state

m-traditional.mode: back-to-back inference, not 1Hz app steady state

s-calibrated.scope: cached decoded frame, transforms + ORT + postprocess

s-sliced.scope: cached decoded frame, transforms + ORT + postprocess

n-e2e-clahe.scope: whole run_method: preprocessing, ONNX inference, inverse mapping and merging
n-e2e-clahe.rss_scope: maximum process RSS sampled after each timed iteration

n-e2e-flip.scope: whole run_method: preprocessing, ONNX inference, inverse mapping and merging
n-e2e-flip.rss_scope: maximum process RSS sampled after each timed iteration

s-traditional-gamma.scope: whole run_method: preprocessing, ONNX inference, inverse mapping and merging
s-traditional-gamma.rss_scope: maximum process RSS sampled after each timed iteration

rf-detr-nano.model: RF-DETR Nano official COCO pretrained ONNX
rf-detr-nano.scope: cached decoded RGB + official half-pixel resize/normalization + ORT inference + output postprocessing
rf-detr-nano.excluded_from_timing: Pillow image decode and RGB conversion
rf-detr-nano.peak_rss_scope: process ru_maxrss after session construction, one image decode, warmup, and timed loop

rf_event_replay.clock: accelerated video-relative seconds; no real-time notification latency claim
rf_event_replay.region: production region_for_box using original frame width and restored pixel boxes

rf_decoder_parity.method: Both decoders start at frame zero and decode sequentially; OpenCV BGR output is converted to RGB. Target index is round(review_time * manifest fps).
